title: Classic American Cheeseburger
description: The perfect homemade cheeseburger with juicy beef patties, melted cheese, and all the classic toppings.
instructions:
1. In a large bowl, gently mix ground beef with salt and pepper. Be careful not to overwork the meat. Divide into 4 equal portions and shape into patties about 3/4 inch thick. Make a small indent in the center of each patty with your thumb to prevent bulging during cooking.
2. Preheat a grill or cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat. Lightly oil the cooking surface.
3. Cook patties for 4-5 minutes on the first side without moving them. Flip and cook for another 3-4 minutes for medium doneness. During the last minute of cooking, place a slice of cheddar cheese on each patty and cover with a lid to melt the cheese.
4. While burgers cook, lightly toast the burger buns on the grill or in a separate pan until golden.
5. Assemble burgers: Spread mayonnaise and ketchup on the bottom bun. Add lettuce leaves, tomato slices, and pickles. Place the cheese-topped patty on top, then add onion slices.
6. Top with the upper bun and serve immediately with french fries or potato chips.
